engineeringSkip.reason: Entanglement cannot transmit information, so 'zero-latency quantum-linked cities' has no basis in known physics — it is a buzzword mash-up rather than a real technology.

factCheck.reason: Quantum entanglement cannot carry information — measuring one particle tells you about the other, but you still need an ordinary (light-speed) channel to learn the result, so it can never give a city zero-latency communications.
